name: Tennessee
source: Tennessee levies no personal income tax: the Hall income tax on interest and dividends was cut to 1% for 2020 and repealed for tax years beginning January 1, 2021 (Department of Revenue, Hall Income Tax due date and tax rates page, https://www.tn.gov/revenue/taxes/hall-income-tax/due-date-and-tax-rates.html, read 2026-10-24 in s359); wages were never taxed, and Tennessee Constitution Art. II sec. 28 (2014 amendment) bars any state or local tax on payroll or earned personal income (text read on https://law.justia.com/constitution/tennessee/article-ii/section-28/); second sources: HIT-3 (https://revenue.support.tn.gov/hc/en-us/articles/360057828631, refuses fetches), UT MTAS Hall income tax page and Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets 2026

filing_tables.note: No income tax, so every filing status uses the one zero-rate table (Department of Revenue: Hall income tax repealed from 2021, read 2026-10-24).

state_base.note: Tennessee has no state income tax: no wage tax, and the Hall tax on interest and dividends was repealed for tax years from January 1, 2021 (Department of Revenue, read 2026-10-24), so nothing is added back.

income_brackets.note: A single 0% bracket: no tax on wages, and the Hall tax (1% in 2020) repealed from 2021 (Department of Revenue, read 2026-10-24). Legislated: a repeal, nothing to index.

estate_inheritance.check_at: Tennessee Code title 67, chapter 8 (inheritance tax repealed for deaths from 2016)
estate_inheritance.note: Tennessee levies no estate tax and no inheritance tax: its inheritance tax was repealed for deaths on or after January 1, 2016 and its gift tax in 2012 (state-costs.csv columns estate_tax and inheritance_tax; Tax Foundation and Kiplinger state death-tax lists). Triage 2026-10-23 (category A): TN estate/inheritance tax repealed from 2016.

social_security.note: Tennessee has no personal income tax since the Hall tax repeal of 2021 (Department of Revenue, read 2026-10-24), so Social Security benefits are not taxed.

local_income_tax.check_at: Tennessee city and county tax codes (no local income tax is authorised)
local_income_tax.note: Tennessee counties and cities levy no income tax (state-costs.csv local_income_tax 'none'; no agency page read). Triage 2026-10-23 (category A): Tennessee has no local income tax. Re-checked 2026-10-24 (s359): Tennessee Constitution Art. II sec. 28 bars any local tax on payroll or earned personal income (read on Justia, not an official state copy), so it stays confirmed secondary.

sales_tax.check_at: Tennessee revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://www.avalara.com/us/en/blog/2026/02/will-tennessee-exempt-groceries-from-sales-tax and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.073 from the state's own source (Tennessee 7% state tax on the full price plus local tax on the first 1,600 and the 2.75% single-article tax on 1,600 to 3,200, about 7.3% on a 29,100 car (secondary: MTAS local option sales tax page, https://www.mtas.tennessee.edu/reference/local-option-sales-tax, validation run 2)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.04) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: yes); research note: Reduced state food rate 4% plus full local option; 2026 repeal bills stalled; HB 2186 lets metro counties cut local food rate from 2026-10-01. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.check_at: Tennessee county clerk registration pages and the CTAS wheel tax list
car_taxes.source: carregistrationfee.com Tennessee guide and feecalculator.us, 2026 (state fee 26.50; county wheel tax 0 to about 75, Davidson 55 to 74, Shelby 75)
car_taxes.note: Tennessee: state registration of 26.50 plus a county wheel tax of 0 to about 75; about 75 a year for a typical car in a populous county. No vehicle property tax. Typical car, averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand after the import: rerunning importStateCosts.py resets it to 0. Accepted: low impact (triage 2026-10-23): Blended wheel tax plus registration.

fuel.source: Excise: https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/marketing/monthly/xls/fueltaxes.xlsx (validation run 3, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel; average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Gas excise confirmed primary: 0.274 (0.26 excise + 0.014: Special Privilege Tax 0.0100 + Environmental Assurance fee 0.0040), July 2026 revised sheet (validation run 3, 2026-10-22). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 3, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Tennessee insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
